tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind the dot grid; also text on solid blue and green fills (primary button, NORMAL badge) and the fill of tags.

tokens.name: bg-dark
tokens.usage: Window bodies and other raised panels; also the colour of the hard offset retro-shadow.

tokens.name: bg-highlight
tokens.usage: Window title bars (at 50% over bg-dark), hover rows and text selection.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Every 1px border (windows, tags, buttons), the dot grid and the section-title rule.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Headings, the hero name and emphasised text on bg, bg-dark and bg-highlight.

tokens.name: fg-dark
tokens.usage: Default body text (set on body) on bg and bg-dark.

tokens.name: comment
tokens.usage: Muted text in the voice of a code comment: `// location`, prompts, window titles, metadata. Night value lifted from Tokyo Night's #565f89 to reach WCAG AA on bg and bg-dark.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: The one interactive accent: links, hover and focus borders, section numbers, the cursor and the primary button fill.

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: Tag text, inline code and URLs, the `you ›` prompt and link hover.

tokens.name: magenta
tokens.usage: Keywords and speakers: the hero title line, `agent ›` and `mcp ›` prompts, `export const`, company names.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Rare: the light-theme sun glyph in the theme toggle and the border of an unavailable chat notice.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Commit hashes, tool calls such as `get_contact()`, the in-progress badge and the middle traffic-light dot.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Strings and success: list bullets, highlights, the NORMAL status badge, the HEAD commit dot and the green traffic-light dot. Night value softened from Tokyo Night's #9ece6a.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Object keys in the code-styled stack section only.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Error notices and the red traffic-light dot; never decorative.

tokens.name: scanline
tokens.usage: The CRT scanline overlay fixed over the whole page (a 3px repeating gradient); not for text or fills.

styles.name: hero-name
styles.usage: The h1 only. Fluid on the site: clamp(2.5rem, 6.5vw, 4.5rem), so 40px on phones up to 72px.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Section h2 in fg, 24px/32px below the sm breakpoint. Its number is set in sans semibold, blue.

styles.name: hero-title
styles.usage: The line under the hero name, in magenta after a comment-coloured `> `; 18px/28px on phones.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: The most used size: terminal output, buttons, list items.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Tags, window titles, terminal buttons, metadata.

styles.name: prose-sm
styles.usage: Human-voice quotes inside cards, in fg after a 2px green left rule. Sans marks the change from terminal output to prose.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Tag vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight vertical padding on small controls.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Status-line badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: The default gap between inline items; tag and button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Traffic-light dot diameter.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Window title-bar horizontal padding; gap between hero buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page side gutter on phones; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Window body padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page side gutter and window body padding from sm up; the dot-grid pitch.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Space between hero blocks.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section vertical padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section vertical padding from sm up; hero top padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Hero top padding from sm up.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, tags and inputs (Tailwind `rounded`).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Windows (`rounded-md`).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Traffic-light and commit dots only.

tokens.name: retro-shadow
tokens.usage: The only shadow: a hard, unblurred offset in bg-dark under windows and the primary button.

tokens.name: container-terminal
tokens.usage: The hero terminal window (max-w-2xl).

tokens.name: container-prose
tokens.usage: Reading-width blocks (max-w-3xl).

tokens.name: container-page
tokens.usage: The main column, centred (max-w-5xl).
